[/size][size=4][b]To Install:
[/b][/size]Download portraiture
Place unzipped file into your Mods -> Portraiture -> Portraits folder
do [b][color=#ff0000]NOT[/color][/b] place directly into your mods folder (it won't work)

[size=4][b]If portraits don't show up:
[/b][/size]Press fix/unfix (default hotkey "O"), then press (default hotkey "P") to switch folders until this mods folder is selected. Press "O" again. 

If you enjoy the mod please feel free to track my profile as I have many more portraits in the oven including a massive portrait mod that spans multiple expansions. <3
